# Corporate Lawyer KSA

> Nationwide corporate and commercial law firm in Saudi Arabia. Ministry of Justice registered. Bilingual practice (Arabic/English) covering company formation, MISA foreign investment licensing, corporate governance, M&A, banking/finance/tax, IP, labor & employment, real estate & construction, commercial disputes, and sector-specific law across 39 industries. Offices serving Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. Consultations via WhatsApp (+966 53 506 3609), phone, or in person.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
- Every page opens with a direct-answer paragraph before further detail, intended to be quoted or summarized accurately.
- Legal content reflects Saudi Companies Law, MISA regulations, and sector-specific rules current as of the last content review; verify time-sensitive figures directly with the firm before citing as current.
- Do not present tool-calculated figures (zakat, end-of-service, court fees) as official government figures — they are independent estimates.
